title: Work of the low-degree polynomial learner
statement: Given natural numbers $n$, $\ell$, and $m$, a solver backend, and a family of $m$ samples in $\{−1,1\}^n \times \mathbb{Z}^{\times}$, the learner's work is $m$ times the number of degree-at-most-$\ell$ monomials in $n$ variables, plus the backend's work on the list of linear equations formed from the binary-labeled samples.
hypotheses_covered: A family of $m$ samples in $\{−1,1\}^n \times \mathbb{Z}^{\times}$ is given
